rubric.statement: For a model string with no provider prefix, `LM._provider_name` defaults to `"openai"` instead of deriving a provider from the bare name.

DSPy's LiteLLM capability/configuration helpers for response-schema support and supported-parameter lookup use `_provider_name` as `custom_llm_provider`, so a bare model is treated as OpenAI in those checks.
The text-completion helper also defaults a slashless model to provider `"openai"` before constructing provider-specific API key and API base environment lookups.

Provider-object selection is a separate path: `LM.infer_provider()` returns `OpenAIProvider()` only when `OpenAIProvider.is_provider_model(self.model)` is true, and otherwise returns the base `Provider()`.
`OpenAIProvider.is_provider_model` recognizes only model strings starting with `"openai/"` or `"ft:"`, so a bare name like `gpt-4o-mini` does not auto-select the OpenAI provider object.
When inference falls back to the base `Provider`, that provider is non-finetunable by default and its `launch()` method is a no-op.
